name: Jochebed
overview: Jochebed, a daughter of Levi, is the faithful mother of Miriam, Aaron, and Moses, as shown in Exodus 2:1-2. When she saw that her son Moses was a fine child, she courageously hid him for three months to protect him from Pharaoh's decree. Unable to hide him longer, she placed him in a carefully prepared ark by the river, demonstrating her trust in God's providence (Exodus 2:3). Her faithfulness is further seen as she nurses Moses after Pharaoh's daughter adopts him, ensuring his well-being during this critical time (Exodus 2:4-6).
